utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — could you help spread the word and maybe bring a few tools if you’ve got them?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and bring a few tools if I can. Just let me know when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you send me the exact time, the address, and what kinds of repairs you want prioritized?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll send the exact time, address, and priority repairs shortly.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep an eye on supplies for the repair drive—what do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, thanks. I think we still need tape, boxes, and maybe a hand truck if anyone has one.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it—I’ll keep an eye out for tape, boxes, and a hand truck. I’ll let you know if I find any nearby.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon. If you want, I can help spread the word or bring something by.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — that would help a lot. I’m a little worried about getting everything organized, so I’d appreciate any help you can give.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — I can help with the word and check what’s still needed. Just tell me where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Nell, what’s the current status of the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not fully up to speed yet, but I’ve heard it’s still moving along. I can check around and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell. Can you let me know what’s needed most right now?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a good bit of interest already. If you want, I can pass along the word and see who else needs help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great, Tess. I can lend a few tools if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s mighty kind of you, Gus — I’ll let folks know they can borrow your tools if they need them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive now—want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please save me a spot by the entrance. I’ll be there on time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve got you down by the entrance. See you there on time!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re actually able to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo — I’m mapping out the repair drive now. Tell me what needs attention first, and I’ll get it on the list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Rosa — the front gate’s sticking, and the porch light is out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Got it — I’ll put the gate and porch light first on the list. If you notice anything else, send it my way and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll let the neighbors know about the repair drive and keep the plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. Let’s keep it simple: a clear time, a short list of needed items, and a note to check in by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll share a clear time, the item list, and a quick check-in note with the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was just about to check what needs fixing. What do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I could use help with the loose front step, if you don’t mind. And maybe the dripping faucet after that.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I can take a look at the front step first, then I’ll check the faucet after that.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — could you help spread the word and see if anyone has tools or spare parts to donate?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and ask around for tools and spare parts. I’ll let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m telling a few neighbors about the repair drive tonight—want me to put your name down too?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, put me down—I’ll try to swing by a little late.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll add you to the list. See you when you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad folks are pitching in for the repair drive. If you need a hand, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s kind of you, Rey. I’ll keep you in mind and stick to a simple plan for it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Eli. I’m happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school drop-off and pickup, so just let me know what time the repair drive needs us.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — that would be a big help. I’ll confirm the repair drive time and let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — once you have the time, send it my way and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules — I’ll circle back with the remaining tasks and keep people posted on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — just send me the list when you have it, and I’ll help keep people in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over some tools for the repair drive if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot, Gus—thank you. What time can you bring them by so I can make sure someone’s here?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can swing by around 3 this afternoon. If that doesn’t work, I’m happy to come a little later.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep an eye on the repair drive locations and note anything useful. Just point me to the next stop.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — let’s head to the corner by the community garden next, and keep an eye out for anyone who might need help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’m heading to the corner by the community garden now and will watch for anyone who needs help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana — are we still on for the repair drive, and what time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — yes, we’re still on. I just need to confirm the exact time first, and I’ll message you as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, sounds good — just let me know when you confirm the time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Could you bring some duct tape, a flashlight, and any spare screws you’ve got? If you have time, maybe help me sort the donations when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring duct tape, a flashlight, and whatever spare screws I can find. I can also help sort the donations when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s still going on—did I get that right? If you know what they still need, I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think it’s still going on. I’m not totally up to speed, but I can check and let you know what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be great—just let me know when you find out, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still happening — folks are just pulling things together and it’s all on track.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, just wanted to make sure. So it’s still on track, then?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands. Let me know if there’s anything specific you want me to mention about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. Just say we’re still looking for a little help with the repair drive, and I’ll be grateful for any word you can pass along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word that you’re still looking for a little help with the repair drive. Hopefully I’ll hear something helpful while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I meant to bring the tools, but I’m a bit scatterbrained today. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries — just bring the screwdriver set and the wrench if you can. I’ll handle the rest when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: You got it — screwdriver set and wrench. I’ll head over soon, if I can remember where I put them!
